title: Vydyvo
profTagline: A living screensaver: a new picture from your words every few minutes, lit for your theme.
installDesc: Works offline, opens like an app
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home screen.
eNetwork: No connection. The show goes on from the collection
eRate: Too many requests. Pausing a few minutes
eBusy: Every GPU is taken. Pausing a few minutes
eTimeout: The picture took too long. Trying later
eSignIn: Sign in so new pictures can be painted
l_2: Light does not fight the dark; it simply is
l_3: The deepest place is where you stop looking
l_4: Time takes nothing away; it returns things to the earth
l_5: Memory keeps not the events but the light they happened in
l_6: What shines does not have to burn
